howToJoin.title: How to Become a Verified OTOX Driver
howToJoin.subtitle: Get verified in 4 simple steps and receive your official driver kit.

steps.title: Submit Basic Details
steps.description: Fill out the registration form with your phone number, vehicle registration number, and city.

steps.title: Verify Driving Credentials
steps.description: Upload a photo of your valid commercial Driving License (DL) and Auto Registration Certificate (RC).

steps.title: Collect Your OTOX QR Kit
steps.description: Receive your weatherproof, tamper-resistant OTOX QR sticker and official Driver ID badge.

steps.title: Stick QR & Start Verifying
steps.description: Affix the QR inside your auto. When passengers scan, your ride is instantly authenticated!

driverPerks: Zero cancellation penalties — you remain your own boss

driverFaq.q: Does OTOX charge a commission on my passenger fare?
driverFaq.a: No! OTOX is a ride verification and safety platform, not a fare deduction platform. You collect your normal agreed meter/street fare directly from the passenger.

driverFaq.q: What documents do I need to register?
driverFaq.a: You need a valid commercial Auto Driver's License, Vehicle Registration Certificate (RC), and Aadhaar / Voter ID for KYC verification.
Once your documents are submitted, our local verification hub usually reviews and approves them within 24 to 48 hours.

driverFaq.q: What if my QR code sticker gets damaged?
driverFaq.a: You can request a free replacement QR sticker directly through the OTOX Driver app or pick one up from any partner hub in your city.
